definition: Llion Jones is a Welsh machine learning researcher, co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI.

story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. That is Llion Jones — a small key that opens a big door.
